233296.note: The pin is on the lookout on the open summit, and the drawn road ends at it.

234138.note: The pin is on the cabin in the open pines, and the drawn road up through the clearing passes beside it.

234155.note: The pin is beside the lookout's white building in the forest clearing, and the drawn road ends at it. The listing's own point, 970 m east, is in unbroken forest.

234159.note: The pin is on the lookout at the end of the drawn road on the open ridge.

234173.note: The pin is on the lookout's site at the end of the drawn spur, in a gravel clearing with buildings beside it.

234179.note: Neither the Forest Service's point 100 m northeast, under conifers just off the drawn road, nor the pin in dense forest by the end of the drawn lane shows a building in the photo. Not moved.

234185.note: The pin is beside the lookout cabin and its outbuildings on the open ridge, and the drawn road ends at them.

234269.note: The pin is on the guard station's building in the clearing, and the drawn loop drive off the road passes 15 m north of it.

234271.note: The pin is on the lookout cabin among its outbuildings on the open ridge, and the drawn road passes right beside it.

234293.note: The round yurt and its deck show 80 m northeast of the pin, at the end of the drawn loop; the pin was in unbroken forest.

234305.note: The pin is on the cabin across the river from the parking area, and the drawn road ends at the lot 25 m west; the other two buildings by the lot are likely its neighbors.

234322.note: The pin is on the cabin among the ranch buildings in the aspens, and the drawn road ends 30 m from it.

234327.note: The photo is a winter one: the pin is beside a small structure in the snow among scattered trees. No road is drawn and the nearest drawn trail is 340 m off; the tracks in the snow aren't traced.

234335.note: The Forest Service's point, 140 m west of the pin across the forks of Fox Creek, is under closed conifers on a creek bank, and neither the photo nor the dense ground relief shows a roof, building gap or levelled pad there; the pin's terrace shows none either. Not moved.

234340.note: The pin is in a small clearing beside the cabin, 15 m east of where the drawn spur off the highway ends.

234341.note: No road reaches it, but the pin is on the lookout at the top of the open ridge, with a drawn trail passing 4 m away.

Nothing traced.

234356.note: The pin is beside the guard station's buildings at the meadow's edge, and the drawn drive off the valley road runs to them.

234358.note: The pin is on the lookout on the open butte, and the drawn road climbs to within 35 m of it along the visible track.

234359.note: The listing's own point is beside a small gray-roofed cabin at the end of a gravel road in pine-dotted grassland; the pin was 10 km east on bare badland slopes.

234360.note: The pin is beside the lookout's building in its small clearing, at the drawn loop that ends the road up the hill.

234364.note: The pin is on the cabin in its fenced yard in the open meadow, and the drawn spur off the road reaches it.

234368.note: The pin is on an open grassy slope at the forest edge, and neither it, the listing's own point 220 m south in dense forest, nor a 1 km view shows any building that could be the cabin.

234377.note: The lidar survey stops about 10 m east of the pin (it covers only the west half of the frame, at 0.95 ground points per square meter), and its relief shows neither the road nor a pad near the pin; the photo shows a small dark shape at the end of the drawn spur, 15 m northeast of the pin, that can't be told for the cabin. Nothing traced.

234383.note: The pin is in unbroken forest with snow patches, and the listing's own point, 860 m northwest, is on an open, partly snow-covered ridge with no lookout plainly shown; nothing on the photo is the lookout.

234386.note: No road is drawn, but the pin is at the top of the open summit clearing, where the lookout's site shows, with a drawn trail 40 m off.

234390.note: The pin is on the lookout's white building at the edge of the clearing, and a drawn spur off the loop road ends 25 m north of it.

234391.note: The pin is on the cabin in the open grassland. The drawn Census line passed 55 m south across open ground, so the gravel drive from it to the cabin, plain on the photo, is traced.

234392.note: The pin is on the cabin at the forest edge, and the drawn road passes right beside it.

234397.note: The pin is on the cabin at the meadow's edge, and the drawn spur off the Census road comes within 30 m of it.

234404.note: The pin is in open, burned pine forest 120 m from the drawn road, and a 1 km view shows no building or clearing that could be the guard station.

234405.note: The Forest Service's point ("Forest Glen Guard Station (historical)"), 155 m south of the pin across the river, is under trees with no roof, and the pin is on the bare gravel flat by the river; several small buildings stand around (one 50 m southeast of the point, two across the highway), and nothing marks which is the guard station. Not moved.

234409.note: The pin is on the cabin and its outbuildings at the end of the drawn gravel loop off the road.

234410.note: The pin is on a cabin with its own gravel parking clearing, and a short lane runs north from the clearing to the meadow by the green-roofed building, but nothing plainly joins it to the campground lane that shows in the open 45 to 60 m east; the drawn Census spur to the cabin crosses trees where no lane shows. The lidar is too sparse here (1.1 ground points per square meter) to place a lane under the trees. Nothing traced.

234413.note: The pin is on the cabin's white roof, with the drawn road 40 m north and the visible drive in from it. The listing's own point, 400 m west, is on a meadow track with nothing on it.

234414.note: The pin is on the cabin in its clearing, and the drawn drive off the valley road ends at it.

234418.note: The pin is on the cabin beside the gravel yard at the end of the drawn road up the valley.

234419.note: The pin is on one of the cottages inside the drawn loop at the old nursery site, and the loop passes 15 m from it.

234422.note: The pin is on the cabin at the south end of the clearing, and the drawn road from the campground loops ends beside it.

234423.note: The Forest Service's point 29 m south-southwest is on bare summit ground with nothing built on it, and the pin, at the north rim, is beside a small pale object that may be the lookout but isn't plain. Not moved.

234425.note: The pin is at the forest edge where a short visible drive meets the drawn Forest Service road, and a small building may show there, but the drawn road runs through the trees 20 to 30 m east of the visible gravel road along the meadow.

234427.note: The pin is on the guard station's main building among its outbuildings, and the drawn road through the yard passes beside it.

234428.note: The pin is on the lookout's small building on the open ridge, and the drawn road along the ridge passes 15 m north.

234429.note: A small white-roofed lookout stands in a ridge-top clearing at the end of a dirt road, 90 m west of the listing's own point; the pin was 2.7 km away in unbroken forest.

234433.note: The pin is beside the lookout on the open, bare summit, and the drawn road ends 20 m west of it.

234436.note: The pin is on the lookout's building on the summit's bare top, inside the small drawn loop that ends the road up the mountain.

234447.note: The pin is on the lookout in the small summit clearing, but no road or trail is drawn within 700 m. A cleared line runs west from it through the forest, which may be its access, but it can't be followed through the trees.

234461.note: The Forest Service's point 40 m west is on the meadow's edge beside a gravel patch, not on a building, and the station's several buildings (a small pale roof 30 m north of it, a gray-roofed one by the highway) give no sign which is the bunkhouse. Not moved.

234506.note: The pin is on the cabin beside the station's yard, and the drawn road up the meadow passes 30 m west.

234568.note: The pin is in open grass among the station's small buildings, one of them 15 m west. The drawn road passes 50 m north, and the visible track from it down to the buildings isn't drawn.

234600.note: The pin is in a small bare clearing among the pines, where a dark structure shows, at the end of a drawn spur that stops 40 m east of it; the summit has no plain lookout tower in the photo.

234609.note: The pin is in an empty field between private-looking houses, and the listing's own point, 600 m west, is a small clearing with vehicles and tents at the end of a drawn lane; neither plainly shows the guard station.

234659.note: The pin is beside the cabin and its outbuildings at the creek, between two drawn roads that pass within 20 m.

234661.note: The listing's own point is on a green-roofed cabin with a parking area beside it, 190 m northwest of the pin, which was in unbroken forest; a smaller green-roofed shed 100 m west of the pin is likely an outbuilding.

234680.note: The pin is on the cabin in its clearing among the junipers, and the drawn road ends at it.

234682.note: The pin is under the trees 10 m south of one of the station's buildings, and a drawn lane comes within 30 m. The station's several buildings are spread over 60 m, so which one is the unit isn't plain.

250027.note: The pin is on the house's metal roof, and the drawn lane passes 15 m north of it.

250044.note: The pin is on the group site's cluster of tents and trailers by the lakeshore, inside the drawn loop off the campground road.

251546.note: The pin is on the lookout's white building at the summit's forest edge, and the drawn road switchbacks up to it.

251565.note: The pin is on the guard station's buildings in the yard by the canyon road, and the drawn drive off the road reaches it.

251905.note: Under the larch and fir the lidar relief shows a levelled clearing about 25 m across at the pin, with a short drive up to Whitetail Camp Road, and the intensity shows the camp road as a dark band that the drawn lane follows within a few meters, 18 m north of the pin. The yurt itself doesn't show in either layer or the photo. Nothing traced.

253500.note: The pin is beside the cabin's white roof at the forest edge, with a short visible pull-in to the drawn road 25 m north.

264411.note: The pin is on the lodge above the lakeshore. The drawn campground road passed 75 m west, so the gravel lane from it past the lodge, plain in the open, is traced.

251709.note: Under the cottonwoods the lidar intensity shows a mown lawn about 40 m across at the pin, beside the dirt parking clearing where the drawn park road ends 30 m northeast; that reads as the group site with its parking, though no pads or shelter show. Nothing traced.
